args.command:
bead create --title "Add --tag flag to search CLI options" --description "Add the --tag flag to the search command CLI options structure.

## Scope
- Add --tag flag to search CLI options
- Ensure it accepts a single tag value or comma-separated list

## Acceptance Criteria
- \`agentscribe search --tag <tag>\` is accepted without CLI parsing error
- Flag is properly typed and stored in search options struct
- Help text shows the new flag" --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 1: Add --tag flag to search CLI

args.command:
bead create --title "Wire annotation tag merging into search execution" --description "Ensure that \`merge_annotation_tags()\` from annotations.rs is called within \`execute_search()\` so that sidecar annotation tags are included in tag filtering.

## Scope
- Verify \`merge_annotation_tags()\` exists in annotations.rs
- Call it in \`execute_search()\` to merge sidecar tags with indexed tags
- Pass merged tags to the filtering logic

## Acceptance Criteria
- Annotation tags from sidecar files are read and merged
- Tag filtering considers both indexed and annotation tags
- Sessions with annotation tags are returned when filtered by those tags" --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 2: Wire annotation tag merging

args.command:
bead create --title "Add annotation tags to reflect sessions output" --description "Modify the \`agentscribe reflect sessions\` output to include annotation tags (from sidecar files) alongside enrichment tags.

## Scope
- Update reflect sessions output logic to read annotation sidecar files
- Merge annotation tags with enrichment tags for display
- Format tags column to show both types clearly

## Acceptance Criteria
- \`agentscribe reflect sessions\` shows annotation tags in the tags column
- Output distinguishes or merges enrichment and annotation tags appropriately
- Sessions without annotation sidecars still show enrichment tags only" --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 3: Add annotation tags to reflect output

args.command:
bead create --title "Validate integrated annotation tag functionality" --description "End-to-end testing of annotation tag integration across search and reflect commands.

## Scope
- Test complete workflow: annotate session → search by tag → reflect sessions
- Verify AND logic works across tag types
- Ensure no errors or performance regression on sessions without sidecars

## Acceptance Criteria
- After annotating a session, \`agentscribe search --tag <that-tag>\` returns it
- \`agentscribe reflect sessions\` shows annotation tags in tags column
- Tag filtering works with AND logic across indexed and annotation tags
- Sessions without annotation sidecars have no errors and no performance regression
- All parent acceptance criteria are satisfied" --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 4: Validate complete functionality
